odds.summitRule: Platinum and Aeon get summit strikes after the four strikes. A summit strike appears only when the capsule really is Platinum or Aeon.

info.title: Odds and how capsules work
info.bankCap: Holds up to {n}. When full, it stops filling.
info.chargesRule: Every {h} hours the Sundial readies a capsule. Finish any battle to claim it, win or lose. The tutorial and a Retreat don't count.
info.supplyRule: The Supply Capsule has retired. Allowance you had left still turns into a Supply Capsule every {n} matches.
info.dailyRule: +1 each day. A Daily Challenge win uses one and pays an Age Capsule.
info.clayRule: Ladder battles that bring no capsule fill it. {n} pips make a Clay Capsule.
info.kept: Nothing you have earned is ever taken away.
info.rookie: Your first opponents make extra mistakes while you learn. After that, ladder opponents adapt to your recent results. In Quick Battle and Skirmish you pick the difficulty.

parents.noMoney: Nothing in Ageborn can be bought, and it shows no ads.
parents.noChat: There is no chat. Players cannot contact each other. All opponents are AI.
parents.noData: No data leaves this device. Progress is saved in this browser.
parents.capsules: Capsules are earned by playing. Each one is decided when it is earned, and its odds are shown.
parents.breaks: A break reminder appears after 60 minutes of play. You can switch it off or on here.
parents.kept: Taking a break never takes away anything your child has earned.

sundial.title: The Sundial
sundial.body: Capsules now come from the Sundial. It readies one every {h} hours and holds up to {max}. Finish any battle to claim one, win or lose. Your charges are now ready capsules, and Supply allowance you had left still turns into Supply Capsules.
sundial.bodyNoSupply: Capsules now come from the Sundial. It readies one every {h} hours and holds up to {max}. Finish any battle to claim one, win or lose. Your charges are now ready capsules.

capsuleLadder.title: Two new capsule tiers
capsuleLadder.body: Gold and Platinum join the ladder above Jade, and Aeon now holds 3 Legendaries. Jade no longer turns a Rare into a Legendary. Unopened Aeon Capsules keep what they hold, get 100 Dust more and are now called Gold. The Aeons left in your current bag stay Aeon.
capsuleLadder.legacy: You had already earned {n} of the skill Aeons (Trophy Road 4,000, Conquest 27 stars, the War Path finale), so {n} new Aeon Capsules were added to your shelf.
capsuleLadder.legacyOne: You had already earned one of the skill Aeons (Trophy Road 4,000, Conquest 27 stars, the War Path finale), so a new Aeon Capsule was added to your shelf.

role.wall: Stops a wave inside your turret cover, so your turrets get time to shoot.
role.tower: A tower that stands still in front of your base and shoots ground and air.
role.camp: Sends a very weak levy every 10 s (1 at a time) that costs you nothing. Levies always march.
role.trap: A visible patch that fires when an enemy walks on it. It cannot be hit and never blocks.

answer.wall: Beat it with Heavies, siege or artillery (×2). Air flies over it and drops land behind it.
answer.tower: Beat it with Heavies (×2) or artillery, which outranges it. Infantry that reach it win.
answer.camp: Splash clears the levies. Heavies break the camp ×2.
answer.trap: Send a cheap unit first to spring it. Air never sets it off.

fort.levy: {hp} HP, {dmg} damage. It takes no army space and pays the enemy no bounty.
fort.level: No levels: a fort is as strong as the average level of your troops in this age.

lastBase.title: Last Base Standing
lastBase.what: No Final Bell and no countdown. The war ends when a base falls.
lastBase.siege: Siege begins at {from} and rises every {every} min: bases take more damage, turrets deal less.
lastBase.crumble: From {crumble}, the side fighting in its own half crumbles, so every war ends by about {end} min.
lastBase.rewards: No trophies, win or lose. A win pays Amber like a Long War. Every finished war claims a ready Sundial capsule; a Retreat pays nothing.
lastBase.closing: Closing the game ends the war with no result.
